items.q: If the perimeter P of a rectangle is 2l + 2w, make l the subject.
hints: Isolate the l-term first, then divide by its coefficient.

items.q: If C = 5n + 7, make n the subject.
hints: Isolate the n-term first, then divide by its coefficient.

items.q: If A = bh/2, make h the subject.
hints: Multiply both sides by 2 first, then divide by b.

items.q: If V = lwh, make w the subject.
hints: Divide both sides by everything multiplying w.

items.q: If F = 9c/5 + 32, make c the subject.
hints: Isolate the fraction term first, then multiply and divide to clear it.

items.q: If d = st, make s the subject.

hints: Isolate the x-term first, then divide by its coefficient.

items.q: Make r the subject: A = pi r^2.
hints: Divide by pi first, then take the square root of both sides.

items.q: Make t the subject: v = u + at.
hints: Isolate the at-term first, then divide by a.
Isolate the 2b-term first, then divide by 2.

items.q: Make m the subject: C = mn + p.
hints: Isolate the mn-term first, then divide by n.

items.q: Make x the subject: k = x/7 - 2.
hints: Isolate the fraction term first, then multiply to clear the denominator.
Collect the like x-terms on the right first, then divide.
Collect the like y-terms first, then isolate the y-term.

items.q: Make a the subject: K = 4a - a + 9.
hints: Collect the like a-terms first, then isolate the a-term.
Collect the like t-terms on the right first, then divide.

items.q: Make p the subject: M = 6p - p + 10.
hints: Collect the like p-terms first, then isolate the p-term.

items.q: Make n the subject: Q = 8n + n - 18.
hints: Collect the like n-terms first, then isolate the n-term.

items.q: Make x the subject: ax + b = cx + d.
hints: Gather all the x-terms on one side and everything else on the other, then factor out x.
ax - cx = d - b, so x(a - c) = d - b.
